wbc_source_trace.interpretation: Review raw value, unit, reference range, flag, timestamp and processed hourly value. This script flags records for review; it does not decide clinical plausibility or delete them.

vae_independent_outcome_evaluation.clinical_endpoint: in-hospital mortality (MIMIC admissions.hospital_expire_flag; deathtime used only when flag is missing)
vae_independent_outcome_evaluation.independent_unit: one baseline hour-0 record from the first ICU stay per subject
vae_independent_outcome_evaluation.split_policy: patient-level train/test split preserved; test outcomes were not used to fit cutoffs or CPT
vae_independent_outcome_evaluation.interpretation: This is an independent-outcome check against in-hospital mortality, not proof that the four labels are clinically calibrated. The demo cohort is small; AUC is undefined if the test split contains only one outcome class. Report sample counts and avoid clinical claims.

bayesian_network_independent_outcome_eva.target: independent MIMIC hospital_expire_flag (or documented deathtime fallback)

test_metrics.small_sample_note: Metrics are exploratory; report uncertainty and do not treat this demo cohort as clinical validation.

bayesian_network_independent_outcome_eva.warning: This is a new exploratory outcome-targeted BN, separate from the existing BN that reproduces VAE labels. Small demo-cohort metrics are not clinical validation.

censoring_aware_prognosis_evaluation.event_definition: first model-defined VAE state 3 (Critical), not an independent clinical event
censoring_aware_prognosis_evaluation.independent_unit: first ICU stay per test subject
censoring_aware_prognosis_evaluation.interpretation: Censoring-aware descriptive validation of time to the model-defined Critical label. It is not clinical prognosis validation; states are generated by the same VAE being assessed.
